name: Satake Hiroto
source:
Satake is a rebellious typical son of a great landowner in the island.  His parents has owned a large part of the island. He always come to Honoka residence, where her grandmother had once stay there before, and harass her with his other gang members.

[Edited and roughly translated from [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/natsuuta/]official website[/url].]

[spoiler]His weakness: He is afraid of ghost.[/spoiler]
